comment: The panel carries a REC button on every channel for the hardware's knob recording, and the plugin configures no parameter for it, so no line describes it. The headphone output is the one polyphonic port in the plugin: its channel count is set and the left and right sides are written into two channels, so one cable carries the stereo pair.
